info.name: Cosmic SMS API
info.description: UK business SMS - REST API for sending, tracking and receiving SMS.  Set the collection variables USERNAME and API_PASSWORD (from the web app's Settings page), then every request is ready to send.  Docs: https://www.cosmicsms.com/guide-api · Machine-readable spec: https://www.cosmicsms.com/cosmic-sms-api.md

request.description: Send to 1-500 recipients.  Optional elements: <sendtime>2026-07-01T13:15Z</sendtime> (ISO-8601, omit = send now) and <multilingual>2</multilingual> (0=GSM-7, 1=Unicode, 2=auto).  The response's <batch> id is used by the Status and Cancel requests.
Per-recipient delivery status: DELIVERED, FAILED, REJECTED, UNKNOWN or PENDING.  Set the batch_id variable from a send response.
Messages received on your virtual mobile number.  Optional date-range path segments: /receive/{from}/{to} with dates as yyyyMMddHHmm.  No dates returns the last 24 hours.
Cancels a batch that was scheduled with <sendtime> and has not yet been sent.
Current credit balance for the authenticated account.
